Koḍ. emme id. Tu. erme id. Te. enumu female buffalo; enu, enupa of the buffalo; enu pōtu male buffalo; enu peṇṭi female buffalo. Go. (D. Ma.) ermi , (A. Y.) hermi buffalo; (Tr.) armī , (L.) ermī female buffalo; (MuW.) arm , (MuE.) aṛmi buffalo ( Voc. 352). DED(S) 699.
